verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports pre-/post-request scripts that execute automatically when a request is sent (event = request lifecycle), plus collection runners and CLI automation for chained/sequenced requests, giving a limited form of rule-like automation. However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose rule engine that triggers actions on arbitrary events (e.g., webhooks, schedules, external triggers) beyond the request/response cycle. Missing for 10: event-trigger definitions beyond request send, conditional branching/rule authoring UI, and any independent verification that scripting reliably handles complex 'if event then action' automation (one community note calls scripting 'garbage-tier').
